text:
slo-alert: midnight SLO alert: text-gen tail latency (99.9th) spiked ~260ms compared to baseline across the nightdash window :eyes:
maria: saw the alert, digging into nightly dash now. looks like spike started right after the 02:10 UTC merge. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/nightly/perf?panel=kv_murmur_miss
aj: pulling the nightly CI job for the same window. synthetic load shows p99 jump on seq-32 and seq-512 tests. queuing a bisect.
ci-bot: started bisect: range nightly-2026-03-17..nightly-2026-03-18. worker 1/8 running regression tests.
kevin: profiler quick dump: KV cache miss rate up ~3.7x, avg batch_size down from ~12 -> ~6. also batch_coordinator lock contention increased in stack traces.
lia: found the merge: PR #4523 (commit abc1234) — kernel-selector refactor + prefetched-heuristics change. prefetch_threshold default was changed 0.6 -> 0.3 and tie-breaker for kernel weight modified.
aj: bisect progress: bad at abc1234, good at abc1220. pointing at that commit.
maria: can we try reverting only the prefetch_threshold change in a canary config? if that reduces p99 we can hotfix.
kevin: running a local canary w/ prefetch_threshold=0.55. reproduces: tail latency drops ~180ms locally. KV hit ratio back up.
lia: quick config to test (applied to canary):
```
runtime.prefetch_threshold: 0.55
kernel_selector:
  weight_prefetch: 1.2
  tie_breaker: previous
```
ci-bot: canary job queued: canary/kv-prefetch-restore-2026-03-18-03. checks: perf-suite, unit, smoke.
kevin: additional note from flamegraph: smaller batches cause more frequent kernel handoffs which amplify prefetch misses. the refactor reduced weight on prefetch so selector chose kernels that don't coalesce well.
lia: opening PR #4567 that reverts the prefetch default and adds a guard: if batch_size < 8, prefer previous kernel tie-breaker.
maria: please hold the live rollout until canary completes. @eng-sre can you pause the deployment pipeline for the kernel-selector release? :hand:
slo-alert: canary finished: tail latency returned to baseline on canary instances. kv_murmur_miss dropped to normal. marking tentative resolved; will auto-close if stable for 2h.
aj: bisect log attached (snippet):
```
$ git bisect start
$ git bisect good abc1220
$ git bisect bad abc1234
abc1234 is the first bad commit
```
kevin: CI perf job also confirms: nightly perf job with PR #4567 applied shows p99 back within SLO. no perf-tests failing.
lia: follow-ups: add unit test for batch_coalescing behavior, add nightdash alert for kv_murmur_miss > 2x baseline, update post-merge checklist to include kernel-selector perf smoke.
maria: nice triage. PR 4567 created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567 — labeling as hotfix. I'll draft a short postmortem + graphs for all-hands. thanks everyone :tada:
